scope: Independent read-only review of two new test sources, CMake registration and existing root-executed logs

admission_test_findings.phase_count_correctness: Requests are after the already-observed baseline and strictly before the next Grant: waits5000..1ms yield500 inclusive allowable phases. Equal-time request-before-nextGrant is tested separately, not double-counted.

remaining_gaps: The standard-controller phase geometry and real high-speed adapter tests are complementary, not one coupled simulation. Active R19 hold_standard_uplink, writer freeze and one-shot routing can alter the standard terminal path; displayed intervals are conditional opportunities, not bounds for every R19 execution.
AUX edges, radio service, remote delivery, heartbeat availability and terminal loss are synthetic. Even mathematical_only=false models are illustrative, not validated physical models.
The standard harness does not parse complete radio/MAVLink bytes or reproduce demux/quarantine, E220 hardware queues, live USB readiness and operating-system timing.
The second Vehicle retained-Grant500ms age, combined request100ms guard and variable transport delay is not jointly swept by these new tests.

Hard lease28000 and target30000 constants are retained, but these new admission tests do not complete an actual932-value bulk session or prove all waiting remains accounted during a future admission redesign.

The standalone adapter test covers both equal-timestamp API orders, not execution of the actual firmware loop; timestamp sampling and buffered-but-not-yet-parsed UART bytes remain a further integration case.

No source-build or complete413-test-suite result is asserted by this reviewer. Characterization PASS documents existing mismatch; expected RED remains unresolved until a separately authorized test-first correction.
conclusion: Sources and logs support the stated timing-mismatch characterization. They do not support declaring admission alignment repaired, RF latency bounded,30s acquisition achieved or product deployment acceptable.
